hero.headline: The world's first seasonal meme coin ecosystem
hero.subheadline: 212 collectible coins. 16 global editions. One interconnected economy built on Solana — where culture, timing, and community determine value.

body.text: The Token Game is a Web3 gaming platform built on Solana where every coin tells a story. Each of the 212 coins is tied to a real-world cultural moment — a holiday, a season, a shared human experience — and launches on Raydium during a specific window in the seasonal calendar.
Miss the window and the coin is gone. Catch it early and you're holding a piece of cultural history. The game rewards attention, timing, and community — not just capital.
Built by the Tienko ecosystem, The Token Game is one of seven interconnected platforms sharing a unified coin economy, XP system, and player identity layer.

coinEconomy.heading: The 8-Coin Economy
coinEconomy.subheading: A crafting hierarchy where coins combine into rarer, more powerful assets

tiers.name: TKN
tiers.description: The base currency of The Token Game. Earned through gameplay, quests, and seasonal participation.

tiers.name: GOLD
tiers.description: Crafted from 100 TKN. Represents sustained engagement and early adoption.

tiers.name: OASIS
tiers.description: Crafted from 1,000 GOLD. A rare asset held by dedicated long-term players.

tiers.name: USGC
tiers.description: The apex crafted coin. Crafted from 10 OASIS. Eligible for the highest-yield staking pool.

tiers.name: XP Coin
tiers.description: Non-tradeable. Earned through quests, streaks, and platform activity. Powers the Journey progression system.

tiers.name: ARTFCT
tiers.description: Artifact coin. Non-craftable. Awarded for rare in-game achievements and community milestones.

tiers.name: NTN
tiers.description: Nation coin. Non-craftable. Tied to War Room nation performance and seasonal rankings.

tiers.name: CUR8
tiers.description: Curator coin. Non-craftable. Earned through content curation and community contribution.

editions.heading: 16 Global Editions
editions.subheading: Each edition is a curated collection of 96 coins tied to the culture, seasons, and moments of a specific region

items.name: Journey & XP
items.description: Progress through 7 stages from Wanderer to Legend. Complete quests, hold coins, and earn XP to unlock exclusive rewards and recognition.

items.name: Coin Crafting
items.description: Combine lower-tier coins into rarer assets using the crafting system. Forward and reverse calculators help you plan your strategy.

items.name: War Room
items.description: 19 nations compete in real-time. Stake your loyalty, earn nation coins, and help your region climb the global rankings.

items.name: Seasonal Calendar
items.description: 130+ coin launch windows across 10 seasons. Every coin has a specific window — miss it and it's gone forever.

items.name: Quests
items.description: 30 quests across 6 categories and 4 tiers. Complete challenges to earn XP, coins, and exclusive badges.

items.name: Staking
items.description: Stake USGC (18.5% APY), NYC (24% APY), and TIEN (32% APY) to earn passive yield on your holdings.

items.name: Backstories
items.description: Every coin has a lore entry. 1,582 backstories explore the cultural, historical, and mythological roots of each coin.

items.name: Leaderboards
items.description: Compete on the Season Leaderboard, Coin Leaderboard, and Hall of Legends. The best players are immortalised on-chain.

tienko.heading: The Tienko Ecosystem
tienko.subheading: The Token Game is one of seven platforms sharing a unified economy

body.text: Tienko is the parent ecosystem behind The Token Game. Across seven interconnected platforms, players share a single wallet identity, coin balance, and XP profile. Activity on any platform contributes to your standing across all of them.

The ecosystem is built on Solana for speed and low fees, with Raydium as the primary liquidity layer for all tradeable coins. Every coin launched through The Token Game is a real Solana token with a live market.

cta.heading: Ready to play?
cta.subheading: Connect your Solana wallet and start collecting.

seo.title: About The Token Game — Web3 Seasonal Meme Coin Ecosystem on Solana
seo.description: Learn about The Token Game: 212 seasonal meme coins across 16 global editions, an 8-coin crafting economy, XP journey system, War Room, staking pools, and 1,582 coin backstories — all built on Solana.
